author: The Critical Drinker
description: He was once the toast of Tinseltown, the star of Creed 3, Magazine Dreams and the new face of the MCU, but then it all went down the tubes in one of the most dramatic career implosions in history. Assault charges, court cases, PR disasters... Jonathan Majors didn't just crash and burn, he took off and nuked the site from orbit.
title: Crash And Burn - The Jonathan Majors Story
